prompt_used: A brutally simple physics diagram illustrating two objects in motion. Two identical circles (representing spheres) are drawn side-by-side with generous horizontal spacing. The left circle contains the label X centered inside it. The right circle contains the label Y centered inside it. From the right edge of each circle, a simple straight horizontal arrow points to the right to indicate motion. The arrows should be the same length. The image is illustrative only and not answer-bearing. Style: professional monochrome admissions-test diagram. Use clean black vector-like strokes on a pure white #FFFFFF background. The labels X and Y must be in a Times New Roman-like serif font. No other labels, no extra arrows, no shading, no 3D rendering, and no background clutter.
